Example for a local Python session
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import tables

frame = pd.DataFrame({"units": [2, 5], "price": [4, 3]})
with TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    path = Path(folder) / "demo.h5"
    with pd.HDFStore(path, mode="w") as store:
        store.put("orders", frame, format="table", data_columns=["units"])
        print(store.info())
